postings.title: Data Analyst
postings.text:
Data Analyst
Brightleaf Retail | Chicago, IL | Hybrid

About the role:
Brightleaf Retail is a (fictional) organisation building tools for merchandising. As a Data Analyst you will work with a small cross-functional team and see your work used in decisions every week.

Responsibilities:
- Turn business questions into analyses and recommendations
- Write and optimise queries to answer ad-hoc questions
- Partner with merchandising to define success metrics
- Automate recurring reporting

Requirements:
- 3+ years of relevant experience
- Strong SQL skills: joins, window functions and CTEs on large tables
- Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, financial-style models)
- Hands-on experience building Tableau dashboards
- Solid grounding in Statistics: distributions, confidence intervals, significance
- Excellent written and verbal Communication, including to non-technical audiences
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have:
- Python for data work (Pandas, notebooks, scripting)
- Snowflake experience
